FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF DELHI AT NEW DELHI
(EXAMINATION BRANCH – NON JUDICIAL)
No.91 /Exams-NJ/EC-3/DHC
Date : 27.10.2026
NOTICE
It is notified for information of all concerned that Stage-II, i.e., Interview in respect of
Court Attendant/ Room Attendant (H)/ Court Attendant (S)/ Security Attendant/ Court Attendant
(L) (Open) Examination-2025, will be held as per the following schedule:-
Dates of Interview
12.11.2026, 13.11.2026 and 15.11.2026
Venue
Delhi High Court
The details of reporting time, place and instructions to candidates, etc. will be as per the
Admit Card and the link for downloading the Admit Card for the aforementioned Exam will be
available on the website of this Court from 05.11.2026.
It is further notified that, document verification shall be conducted for candidates two
times the number of vacancies based on merit. The schedule for the same will be notified in
due course. Further, the candidates are advised to visit the official website of this Court viz.
www.delhihighcourt.nic.in regularly, for further updates.
Dalip Kumar Bajaj
(Deputy Registrar)
Examination Branch (Non-Judicial)
